mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_order ( order_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, product_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, tracking_no VARCHAR(128), KEY idx_cs_order_tenant_user (tenant_id, user_id) )
ALTER TABLE cs_order ADD COLUMN tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cs_order(order_id, tenant_id, user_id, product_id, status, tracking_no) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{status}, #{trackingNo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tenant_id = VALUES(tenant_id), user_id = VALUES(user_id), product_id = VALUES(product_id), status = VALUES(status), tracking_no = VALUES(tracking_no)
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, tenant_id, user_id, product_id, status, tracking_no FROM cs_order WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY order_id
